author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices finding A by the black keys, a long-short lilt, how lines repeat and end, and left-hand low notes, using a dreamy old English tune.

classes.title: A is the home key
classes.goal: Find A by the three black keys, set the hand, and learn the opening climb.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the three black keys as a sign to find A

classes.parentPrompt: Touch three black keys together; A is the white key between the second and third.
classes.childAction: Thumb on A, then play A, C, D, E with 1, 3, 4, 5.
classes.bridge: A sits between the last two of three black keys, like a door in a hedge.

intro.caption: Find three black keys
intro.parentCue: A hides between the second and third

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding A by the three black keys.

classes.title: Lean on the black key
classes.goal: Learn the next part, where A leans down to a black key and comes back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Stepping to the next key down and straight back

classes.parentPrompt: Show the black key just left of A; say 'lean and back' as your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play A, lean down to the black key, then back to A.
classes.bridge: A leans on its black-key neighbour, like resting on a garden gate.

intro.caption: A leans on a black key
intro.parentCue: show the black key just left of A

games.caption: Lean and back: A, black, A

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: stepping to a black key and back.

classes.title: Twin lines, two endings
classes.goal: Play the whole tune slowly and hear twin lines that end in two different places.

mathTarget.concept: Form: A B A B' refrain
mathTarget.parentLine: A line comes twice; the ending changes, then a new high part

classes.parentPrompt: Shrug at the first ending; make a roof with your hands at the second.
classes.childAction: Play slowly; say 'not home' or 'home' at each ending.
classes.bridge: The first ending stops on E, still walking; the second rests on A.

intro.caption: Twin lines, two endings
intro.parentCue: ask your child: home, or not home yet?

games.caption: Not home yet: ends on E
games.parentCue: Shrug together on the last note

games.caption: Home: ends on A
games.parentCue: Make a roof with your hands

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing twin lines with different endings.

classes.title: Long step, little step
classes.goal: Practise the lilting rhythm slowly: one long note, then one very short note.

mathTarget.parentLine: One note lasts three times as long as the next

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'loooong-short' with the notes and sway on the long one before your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play E long, F short, then E, D: loooong-short.
classes.bridge: A long dancing step, then a tiny tiptoe, like a slow court dance.

intro.caption: Loooong-short, loooong-short
intro.parentCue: sway on the long note together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a long note and a short note together.

classes.title: Low A, high A
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar, starting on low A.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same note A lives high and low

classes.parentPrompt: Play high A, then help your child find low A on the left: 'Same name, lower house.'
classes.childAction: Left hand plays low A, G, F, E: walking down the stairs.
classes.bridge: Low A is the same A, living downstairs on the left side.

intro.caption: Same A, lower house
intro.parentCue: play high A, then low A

games.caption: Left hand walks down
games.parentCue: Count one, two, three for each note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the same note in a lower place.

classes.title: Left on one, right sings
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left-hand note on each 'one', very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: Left hand plays on 'one'; right hand keeps the tune going

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three' very slowly and tap your child's left hand on each 'one'.
classes.childAction: Left hand on 'one', right hand sings the tune.
classes.bridge: The left hand is the lute player's thumb; the right hand sings the song.

intro.caption: Left on one, right sings
intro.parentCue: tap their left hand on every one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands with different jobs, slowly.

classes.title: A bit faster, still smooth
classes.goal: Play both hands together closer to full speed, keeping the beat steady.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same notes and order, only a little quicker

classes.parentPrompt: If the hands tangle, smile and say 'slow again'; speed comes last.
classes.childAction: Play both hands a little faster; slow down if it tangles.
classes.bridge: The same slow dance, now stepping a little more briskly.

intro.caption: Same dance, a bit quicker
intro.parentCue: go back to slow if it tangles

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping the beat steady at a faster speed.

classes.title: Play with the old tune
classes.goal: Play the whole tune along with the music and keep going to the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping pace with the music, all the way to the end

classes.parentPrompt: Hum the tune beside your child and sway on each 'one'; if they slip, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music; keep going after a slip.
classes.bridge: You and the music dance the same slow steps, side by side.

intro.caption: Dance with the music
intro.parentCue: hum beside your child and keep going

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping pace with the music to the end.

classes.title: A dreamy song for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole tune for teddy, slowly and gently, so it sounds dreamy.

mathTarget.parentLine: Choosing a slow, gentle way to play

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; take a slow breath together before you start, then bow.
classes.childAction: Play gently and slowly for teddy, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: Soft, slow fingers paint the green sleeves floating in the breeze.

intro.caption: A dreamy song for teddy
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front and breathe slowly together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole tune slowly and gently.
